items.summary: Use this skill whenever the agent needs to (1) verify a factual claim against live sources before stating it with confidence, (2) recover from a failed shell...
items.description: Use this skill whenever the agent needs to (1) verify a factual claim against live sources before stating it with confidence, (2) recover from a failed shell command or code execution by diagnosing the error and proposing a bounded, human-approved fix, or (3) read/write small pieces of state that must be shared safely across multiple agent sessions or sub-agents working on the same task. Trigger this skill for fact-checking requests, "it failed, fix it" debugging loops, or any multi-agent workflow where two or more agents need to coordinate through shared variables without overwriting each other's work.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of triskill: a bundle for fact-checking, self-healing command retries, and shared memory coordination.

- Fact-check: Verifies factual claims against live sources with read-only web search, providing result snippets and URLs.
- Self-healing retry loop: Diagnoses failed shell commands and suggests fixes within bounded, human-approved retries and strict safety limits.
- Shared memory: Offers atomic read/write/increment/compare-and-swap operations for agents to coordinate through a JSON store with file-level locking.
- All components are designed with hard safety limits to prevent destructive or insecure actions.
